the development of a new methodology for the modeling of power consumption of complex microprocessors and the development of a tool for the estimation of the power consumption of a given software running on a given microprocessor.

the design of efficient power estimation tools that allow the designer to evaluate the power consumption of the system at different design stages, from early architectural exploration to detailed software design.
the development of an accurate and efficient methodology for estimating the power consumption of a complex processor executing an application program.

The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to accurately estimate the power consumption of a processor when running a given application without the use of a detailed transistor-level model.

the power estimation can be done at a very high level of the design process and that the accuracy of the estimation can be improved by using a functional model of the processor and a parametric model of the consumption.
